story.en: ConnectBook data team meeting. Raj leans back and says: "We have likes and comments in separate tables. I want one unified activity feed — every interaction, who did it, on which post, and when. Marketing needs this for the engagement dashboard." UNION ALL is your friend today.
story.ta: ConnectBook data team meeting. Raj saayadhu solla: "Likes-um comments-um separate tables-la irukku. Oru unified activity feed venum — ella interaction-um, yaar panna, edu post-la, epppo pannanga. Marketing-ku engagement dashboard-ku idu venum." Ippa UNION ALL use pannanum.
story.hi: ConnectBook data team meeting. Raj ne peeche jhauk ke kaha: "Likes aur comments alag alag tables mein hain. Ek unified activity feed chahiye — har interaction, kisne kiya, kis post pe, kab kiya. Marketing ko engagement dashboard ke liye chahiye." Aaj UNION ALL tumhara dost hai.
story.te: ConnectBook data team meeting. Raj yenakki jaaripoyi annadu: "Likes mariyu comments separate tables lo unnaayi. Oka unified activity feed kavali — anni interactions, evaru chesaaru, edu post lo, eppudu chesaaru. Marketing ki engagement dashboard ki idi kavali." UNION ALL meeru sahayam chesindi.

question.en: Combine likes and comments into one activity feed. Each row should show activity type (like or comment), the user who did it, the post_id, and the timestamp. Order by timestamp descending.
question.ta: Likes-um comments-um oru activity feed-aa combine pannu. Prathi row: activity type (like or comment), yaar panna, post_id, timestamp. Timestamp-vari descending order pannanum.
question.hi: Likes aur comments ko ek activity feed mein combine karo. Har row mein: activity type (like ya comment), kisne kiya, post_id, timestamp. Timestamp ke hisaab se descending order karo.
question.te: Likes mariyu comments ni oka activity feed ga combine cheyyali. Prathi row: activity type (like or comment), evaru chesaaru, post_id, timestamp. Timestamp vari descending order cheyyali.

title.en: Query likes with a type label
title.ta: Likes-a type label oda query pannu
title.hi: Likes ko type label ke saath query karo
title.te: Likes ni type label tho query cheyyandi

steps.sql:
SELECT
  'like' AS activity_type,
  user_id,
  post_id,
  liked_at AS activity_at
FROM likes;

explain.en: The string 'like' AS activity_type hardcodes the word like as a new column for every row. We also rename liked_at to activity_at so it has the same column name as the comments query. Column names and count must match exactly for UNION ALL to work.
explain.ta: 'like' AS activity_type nna literal string constant — prathi row-ku 'like' nu oru new column hardcode panrom. liked_at-a activity_at-aa rename panrom, comments-oda same column name varachchi. UNION ALL work aaganum-naa column names and count exactly match aaganum.
explain.hi: 'like' AS activity_type har row ke liye 'like' word ko nayi column mein hardcode karta hai. liked_at ko activity_at rename kiya taaki comments ke saath same column naam ho. UNION ALL ke liye column naam aur count exactly match karna zaroori hai.
explain.te: 'like' AS activity_type prathi row ki 'like' ani oka new column ga hardcode chestunnamu. liked_at ni activity_at ga rename chesaamu, comments tho same column name vastuundeli. UNION ALL work avvadam ki column names mariyu count exactly match avvali.

title.en: UNION ALL to combine with comments
title.hi: Comments ke saath UNION ALL karo

steps.sql:
SELECT
  'like' AS activity_type,
  user_id, post_id,
  liked_at AS activity_at
FROM likes

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'comment' AS activity_type,
  user_id, post_id,
  commented_at AS activity_at
FROM comments

ORDER BY activity_at DESC;

explain.en: UNION ALL stacks rows from both queries vertically with no deduplication. ORDER BY at the end sorts the combined result. UNION without ALL would remove duplicate rows but is slower. Here we use UNION ALL because a like and a comment on the same post by the same user should both appear as separate events. Raj's dashboard is ready.
explain.ta: UNION ALL rendu queries-oda rows-a vertically stack pannum — duplicate remove illai. End-la ORDER BY combined result-a sort pannum. UNION (ALL illaamal) duplicate rows-a remove pannum aana slow aagidum. Inga UNION ALL use pannom, emi na same post-la like-um comment-um rendu-um separate events-aa varacchi venum. Raj-oda dashboard ready!
explain.hi: UNION ALL dono queries ki rows ko vertically stack karta hai bina deduplication ke. Last mein ORDER BY combined result sort karta hai. UNION bina ALL ke duplicate rows hatata hai but slow hota hai. Yahan UNION ALL use kiya kyunki same post pe like aur comment dono alag alag events ki tarah dikhne chahiye. Raj ka dashboard ready!
explain.te: UNION ALL rendu queries rows ni vertically stack chestundi — deduplication ledi. Chettan ORDER BY combined result ni sort chestundi. UNION (ALL lekunda) duplicate rows ni remove chestundi kaani slow avutundi. Ikkade UNION ALL use chesaamu emi ante same post lo like mariyu comment rendu separate events ga kanavali. Raj dashboard ready!

story.en: ConnectBook audit. Raj comes back with a new problem: "There is a bug in the ingestion pipeline. Some posts got inserted twice — same user, same content, same timestamp, different post_id. We need to deduplicate and keep only the first post_id in each duplicate group." Classic ROW_NUMBER deduplication.
story.ta: ConnectBook audit. Raj thirumba varandaa: "Ingestion pipeline-la bug irukku. Sila posts rendu thadava insert aagiduchu — same user, same content, same timestamp, different post_id. Deduplicate panni prathi duplicate group-la first post_id mattum vachu venum." Classic ROW_NUMBER deduplication!
story.hi: ConnectBook audit. Raj wapas aaya ek nayi problem le ke: "Ingestion pipeline mein bug hai. Kuch posts do baar insert ho gaye — same user, same content, same timestamp, different post_id. Deduplicate karna hai aur har duplicate group mein se pehla post_id rakhna hai." Classic ROW_NUMBER deduplication.
story.te: ConnectBook audit. Raj tirigi ochaadu new problem tho: "Ingestion pipeline lo bug undi. Kొని posts rendu sarlu insert ayyaayi — same user, same content, same timestamp, different post_id. Deduplicate chesi prathi duplicate group lo modati post_id ni maatrame unchali." Classic ROW_NUMBER deduplication!

question.en: Identify duplicate posts (same user_id, same content, same posted_at). Keep only the row with the lowest post_id in each duplicate group. Return all clean, non-duplicate rows.
question.ta: Duplicate posts identify pannu (same user_id, same content, same posted_at). Prathi duplicate group-la lowest post_id irukara row mattum vachu. Ella non-duplicate rows-um return pannu.
question.hi: Duplicate posts identify karo (same user_id, same content, same posted_at). Har duplicate group mein se sirf lowest post_id wali row rakho. Sab clean non-duplicate rows return karo.
question.te: Duplicate posts identify cheyyali (same user_id, same content, same posted_at). Prathi duplicate group lo lowest post_id unna row ni maatrame unchali. Anni clean non-duplicate rows return cheyyali.

title.en: Label each row in its duplicate group using ROW_NUMBER
title.ta: ROW_NUMBER use panni prathi group-la row-a label pannu
title.hi: ROW_NUMBER se har group mein rows ko label karo
title.te: ROW_NUMBER use chesi prathi group lo rows label cheyyandi

explain.en: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (...) assigns a sequential number to each row within its partition. PARTITION BY user_id, content, posted_at defines what a duplicate group is — rows sharing all three values form one group. Within each group, ORDER BY post_id ensures the lowest post_id gets rn=1. Duplicates get rn=2, rn=3, and so on.
explain.ta: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (...) prathi row-ku group-la sequential number vekkuthu. PARTITION BY user_id, content, posted_at nna 'duplicate group' ennadhu nu define pannum — moondrum same-aa irukara rows oru group. Aa group-la post_id smallest-ku rn=1 varum. Duplicates-ku rn=2, rn=3 etc.
explain.hi: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (...) har row ko uske partition mein sequential number deta hai. PARTITION BY user_id, content, posted_at define karta hai ki duplicate group kya hai — teeno values same wali rows ek group hain. Us group mein sabse chota post_id wale row ko rn=1 milta hai. Duplicates ko rn=2, rn=3 milta hai.
explain.te: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (...) prathi row ki partition lo sequential number isthundi. PARTITION BY user_id, content, posted_at ante duplicate group enti ani define chestundi — moodu values same unna rows oka group. Aa group lo chinna post_id unna row ki rn=1 vasthundi. Duplicates ki rn=2, rn=3 vasthundi.

title.en: Keep only rn=1 to get clean data
title.ta: rn=1 rows mattum vachu — clean data
title.hi: Sirf rn=1 rows rakho — clean data
title.te: rn=1 rows maatrame unchuko — clean data

steps.sql:
WITH ranked_posts AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY user_id, content, posted_at
      ORDER BY post_id
    ) AS rn
  FROM posts
)
SELECT post_id, user_id, content, posted_at
FROM ranked_posts
WHERE rn = 1;

explain.en: WHERE rn = 1 in the outer query keeps only the first row from each duplicate group — the one with the smallest post_id. All duplicates with rn greater than 1 are filtered out. This ROW_NUMBER + CTE + WHERE rn = 1 pattern is the standard deduplication technique in SQL and works across Postgres, MySQL, BigQuery, Snowflake, and SQLite.
explain.ta: WHERE rn = 1 outer query-la prathi duplicate group-la first row mattum varum — adhu smallest post_id irukara row. rn > 1 irukara duplicates filter aagidum. Ee ROW_NUMBER + CTE + WHERE rn=1 pattern SQL-la standard deduplication technique. Postgres, MySQL, BigQuery, Snowflake, SQLite — ella databases-lum work aagidum.
explain.hi: WHERE rn = 1 outer query mein har duplicate group ki pehli row rakhta hai — jo sabse chote post_id wali hai. rn > 1 wale duplicates filter ho jaate hain. Yeh ROW_NUMBER + CTE + WHERE rn=1 pattern SQL ka standard deduplication technique hai aur Postgres, MySQL, BigQuery, Snowflake, SQLite sab mein kaam karta hai.
explain.te: WHERE rn = 1 outer query lo prathi duplicate group lo modati row maatrame unchutundi — adhi smallest post_id unna row. rn > 1 unna duplicates filter avutaayi. Ee ROW_NUMBER + CTE + WHERE rn=1 pattern SQL lo standard deduplication technique. Postgres, MySQL, BigQuery, Snowflake, SQLite — anni databases lo work avutundi.
